content.user_title: Research Notion and Publish Cited Reports
content.value_statement: Important information is often scattered across many Notion pages. This skill finds relevant sources, synthesizes evidence, and publishes cited briefs, comparisons, or reports.
actual_capabilities: Search Notion with targeted queries and ask the user to resolve ambiguous results.
Fetch relevant pages and extract facts, metrics, dates, constraints, and claims.
Organize findings around themes, questions, evidence gaps, and contradictions.
Produce quick briefs, research summaries, comparisons, or comprehensive reports.
Create or update Notion pages with citations, references, risks, open questions, and next steps.
limitations: Requires a configured Notion MCP connection and OAuth access to relevant workspace pages.
Can only analyze content available through the connected Notion account.
The package does not include the referenced templates, citation guide, or examples.
Citation quality depends on source accuracy and completeness. The skill does not independently verify external claims.

use_cases.title: Compare Product Options
use_cases.description: Collect product evidence from Notion and create a cited comparison of benefits, constraints, risks, and unresolved questions.

use_cases.title: Synthesize Project Research
use_cases.description: Combine findings from several project pages into a structured summary with themes, contradictions, evidence gaps, and source links.

use_cases.title: Prepare Executive Briefs
use_cases.description: Turn operational notes, metrics, and decisions into a concise brief with key findings, risks, recommendations, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Notion Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] in Notion. Confirm the scope, find relevant pages, and produce a concise summary with inline citations and a references section.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused research summary

prompt_templates.title: Create a Cited Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] using Notion sources. Cover goals, evidence, tradeoffs, risks, and open questions. Cite every important claim.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate decision support across multiple sources

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Conflicting Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate Notion claims about [question]. Identify agreements, contradictions, missing evidence, and dated information. Create a comprehensive report with direct quotes and citations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced analysis of uncertain or inconsistent workspace information

prompt_templates.title: Refresh an Existing Research Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the Notion report [page]. Find newer sources, reconcile changed claims, preserve verified content, refresh citations, and add a concise changelog and follow-up tasks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced maintenance of a living research document

output_examples.input: Summarize the launch readiness findings for Project Atlas.
output_examples.output: Executive summary: Project Atlas meets the documented product requirements, but support coverage remains unresolved. Key findings include cited readiness evidence, identified risks, and owner-specific next steps.

output_examples.input: Compare the workspace evidence for Vendor North and Vendor South.
output_examples.output: Comparison: Vendor North has stronger integration evidence, while Vendor South has lower documented costs. The report lists supporting Notion sources, tradeoffs, risks, and open questions.

output_examples.input: Update the quarterly market research page with recent Notion findings.
output_examples.output: Updated report: New market signals are integrated with refreshed citations. Superseded claims are marked, unresolved gaps remain visible, and the changelog summarizes every material revision.

best_practices: Confirm the research scope and resolve ambiguous search results before synthesis.
Use direct quotes for critical facts, and preserve each source URL or page ID.
Flag contradictions, missing evidence, risks, and open questions instead of presenting unsupported certainty.
anti_patterns: Do not publish a report before checking that citations support its claims.
Do not combine similarly named pages without asking the user to resolve ambiguity.
Do not overwrite an existing Notion page without confirming the target and intended changes.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Notion connection?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires Notion MCP, remote MCP support in Codex, and OAuth access to the relevant workspace.

faq.question: What documents can it produce?
faq.answer: It can produce quick briefs, research summaries, option comparisons, and comprehensive reports.

faq.question: How does it handle citations?
faq.answer: It records source URLs or page IDs, adds inline citations, and creates a references section.

faq.question: Can it research sources outside Notion?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow searches and fetches sources from the connected Notion workspace.

faq.question: Does it verify that source claims are correct?
faq.answer: No. It can identify contradictions and gaps, but source accuracy still requires human review.

faq.question: Can it update an existing report?
faq.answer: Yes. It can refresh content, citations, status, and changelog information through the Notion update tool.
